svg.title: NEON SPORE · SWIM SHEET
svg.text: one pulse cycle · 2 beats at 96 BPM · gold bar is the bell's contraction, and the tentacles are always behind it
a plain bell + a fringe and four streamers
a wide shallow bell + a scalloped margin, four oral arms and the rings inside
a deep bell + long oral arms, six streamers and a fringe
a small tall bell + a short fringe, squeezing harder than the rest
a bell + three veils and the rings, with almost nothing trailing
an ovoid + comb rows down both sides and one trail
a wide bell whose whole margin is flaps
a small bell + a tangle of trails and streamers far longer than it is
